Companion Animal Travel Desk Intake and Travel Approval

This section explains how the Companion Animal Travel Desk records requests, verifies documents, and supports safe travel for approved animals on Aurelia Skyways.

For boarding, the required form is FM-597, and staff must confirm it before any travel file moves forward. Each case begins with a careful review of the travel record, the animal's basic details, and the customer's stated needs so that the service remains orderly and dependable. Staff must enter the information exactly as provided, check that names and route details match the itinerary, and note any service concerns for review by the senior coordinator.

When a companion animal is accepted for travel, the desk confirms that the customer understands the handling rules, the kennel or carrier is secure, and the journey can proceed without avoidable delay. Staff must keep communication clear and respectful at all stages, since each journey is a shared responsibility between the traveler, the desk, and the flight team. If a record is incomplete, the case remains on hold until the missing item is received and verified. If a condition appears that affects safety, staff must pause the file and refer it for decision before any further action.

The desk also maintains a calm and reassuring tone in every contact, including adjustments, confirmations, and service notes. Travelers receive guidance that is precise and courteous, and staff must avoid informal shortcuts that weaken accuracy. Any exception to standard handling requires direct review and recorded approval within the service file.

For questions about procedure, contact the senior coordinator through the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
